note: 以下题目为基于 UNSW 2026 五科课程范围与个人高频薄弱点编写的巩固练习题（sourceType: practice_pack），与会计 U1–U6 官方 PDF 引文题库严格区分。

packs.title: 会计 U7–U11 核心巩固（试算表 / 报表 / 比率 / 现金流）

questions.prompt: Which of the following errors WILL still allow a Trial Balance to balance (Dr = Cr)?
options: Posting only the debit side of a $500 cash sale
Recording a $300 purchase of office supplies as Debit Purchases $300, Credit Cash $300
Entering $450 on the debit side and $540 on the credit side
Adding the credit column incorrectly by $100
questions.explanation: 记错科目但借贷金额相等（Error of Principle / Commission）不会破坏试算表借贷平衡；单边过账、金额不等或加总错才会导致不平。

questions.prompt: A business sells goods on credit for $7,200. The customer returns $200 of goods and pays within the 1% settlement discount period. What is the Discount Allowed and Cash Received?
On 1 May, a business paid $8,000 for 8 months of rent in advance (recorded as Prepaid Rent). What is the adjusting entry on 30 June?
options: Dr Rent Expense $2,000 / Cr Prepaid Rent $2,000
Dr Rent Expense $6,000 / Cr Prepaid Rent $6,000
Dr Prepaid Rent $6,000 / Cr Rent Expense $6,000
questions.explanation: 5 月 1 日到 6 月 30 日共耗用 2 个月：$8,000 × (2/8) = $2,000 转为当期 Rent Expense，同时冲减资产 Prepaid Rent。

questions.prompt: Where does Accumulated Depreciation appear in a Classified Balance Sheet?
options: As a deduction from the related Non-Current Asset
questions.explanation: Accumulated Depreciation 是资产备抵账户（Contra-Asset），列在对应非流动资产原值下方作扣减以得出 Carrying Amount（账面净值）。

questions.prompt: Current Assets = $50,000 (including Inventory $15,000 and Prepayments $5,000). Current Liabilities = $20,000. What is the Quick (Acid-Test) Ratio?
Cash paid to purchase new delivery equipment is classified under which section of the Statement of Cash Flows?
questions.explanation: 购置或处置长期资产（如设备、房产）属于 Investing Activities（投资活动现金流）。

packs.title: 经济学高频核心（PPC / 弹性 / 外部性 / AD-AS / 宏观政策）

questions.prompt: Why is a typical Production Possibility Curve (PPC) bowed outward (concave to the origin)?
options: Resources are unlimited in the long run
Resources are not equally suited to producing all goods, leading to increasing opportunity cost
Technology improves at a constant rate
All goods have identical opportunity costs
questions.explanation: 核心因果链：resources are not equally suited to producing both goods → increasing opportunity cost → bowed-out PPC。

questions.prompt: If the Price Elasticity of Demand (|PED|) for a product is 0.4, what happens to Total Revenue when the firm raises its price?
questions.explanation: |PED| = 0.4 < 1 属于缺乏弹性（inelastic），涨价带来价格上升比例大于销量下降比例，因此总收益 TR 上升。

questions.prompt: A factory emits air pollution that harms nearby residents without paying for the damage. Which relationship holds at the free-market equilibrium?
options: MSC > MPC, causing overproduction relative to the social optimum
questions.explanation: 负生产外部性使社会边际成本高于私人边际成本（MSC > MPC），市场产量高于社会最优产量，产生无谓损失 DWL。

questions.prompt: Employed = 950, Unemployed = 50. If 10 unemployed workers become discouraged and stop looking for work, what happens to the official unemployment rate?
questions.explanation: 退出后劳动力变为 990、失业变为 40，失业率 = 40/990 ≈ 4.04%。失业率下降是因为分子分母同减，不代表就业好转！

questions.prompt: A sharp rise in global oil and energy prices shifts which curve in the short-run AD-AS model, and what is the result?
options: AD shifts right; higher GDP and higher inflation
SRAS shifts left; lower real GDP and higher price level (cost-push inflation)
SRAS shifts right; higher GDP and lower price level
AD shifts left; lower GDP and lower price level
questions.explanation: 能源成本飙升推高企业生产成本，导致短期总供给 SRAS 左移，出现产出下降与物价上升（成本推动型通胀/滞胀风险）。

packs.title: 商业数学高频防错（E01–E05 / 对数 / 微积分 / 金融 / 概率统计）

questions.prompt: Solve log₂(x − 1) + log₂(x + 1) = 3. What is the valid solution?
questions.explanation: 合并得 (x−1)(x+1)=2³=8 → x²=9 → x=±3。检验定义域需 x−1>0 且 x+1>0 即 x>1，排除非法根 x=−3，仅 x=3（典型 E03 考点）。

questions.prompt: What is the total area bounded by y = x, the x-axis, x = −2, and x = 2?
questions.explanation: 直接积分 ∫₋₂² x dx = 0 会正负抵消！必须按零点 x=0 分段：|∫₋₂⁰ x dx| + ∫₀² x dx = 2 + 2 = 4。

questions.prompt: For which values of common ratio r does the infinite geometric series a + ar + ar² + ... (a ≠ 0) converge?
questions.explanation: 无穷等比级数收敛充要条件是严格满足 |r| < 1（即 −1 < r < 1）；r = ±1 均发散。

questions.prompt: If X ~ B(n = 100, p = 0.2), what are E(X) and the standard deviation SD(X)?
Which description correctly matches the graph of y = ln(−x)?
options: Defined for x > 0, reflected across the x-axis
Defined for x < 0, reflected across the y-axis, vertical asymptote x = 0
Defined for all real x, horizontal asymptote y = 0
questions.explanation: 真数 −x > 0 得定义域 x < 0，是 y = ln(x) 关于 y 轴对称的图像，x 截距为 (−1, 0)，渐近线 x = 0（典型 E02 错题）。

packs.title: 计算机闭卷核心（Excel $ / IF / XLOOKUP / SUMIFS / Word 样式）

questions.prompt: Cell B2 holds price and $E$1 holds the 10% GST rate. You write =B2*$E$1 in C2 and drag down to C10. What formula appears in C5?
questions.explanation: B2 为相对引用随行变为 B5，$E$1 锁定行列保持不变。

questions.prompt: A student passes only if BOTH Quiz (B2) ≥ 50 AND Exam (C2) ≥ 50. Which Excel formula is valid?
questions.explanation: AND 里每个参数必须是完整比较式，且返回文本 Pass/Fail 必须加英文双引号。

questions.prompt: In =XLOOKUP(A2, $F$2:$F$20, $G$2:$G$20, "Missing"), what does the 4th argument "Missing" do?
options: Returns "Missing" instead of #N/A if A2 is not found
questions.explanation: XLOOKUP 第 4 参数是 [if_not_found]，找不到时返回友好文案而非 #N/A 报错。

questions.prompt: Which formula correctly sums Sales (C2:C50) where Region (A2:A50)="NSW" AND Quarter (B2:B50)="Q1"?
questions.explanation: SUMIFS 的第一个参数永远是 sum_range（求和区域 C2:C50），与单条件 SUMIF 正好相反！

questions.prompt: You want Page 2 of a Word document to have Landscape orientation and a different header from Page 1 without affecting Page 1. What must you do?
options: Insert a Page Break and change orientation
Insert a Section Break (Next Page), switch Section 2 to Landscape, and turn off "Link to Previous" in the header
Change the Normal Style to Landscape
questions.explanation: 页面方向与独立页眉都按 Section（节）控制，必须插 Section Break 并取消 Link to Previous。

packs.title: 学术英语高频核心（推断防脑补 / Hedging / 转述动词 / 名词化）

questions.prompt: Passage: "Extended screen time may contribute to reduced sleep quality among adolescents, though family routines also play a role." Which statement is validly supported?
options: Screen time is the sole cause of poor adolescent sleep.
Reducing screen time will definitely cure all sleep disorders.
Screen time is possibly one factor linked to poorer sleep in teenagers.
Family routines have no impact on adolescent sleep.
questions.explanation: 原文用 may（可能）和 also（因素之一），只有选项 C 保留了限定语气；A/B 犯了绝对化（sole/definitely）错误。

questions.prompt: Which sentence demonstrates appropriate academic hedging?
options: AI tools will always ruin students’ critical thinking.
Frequent unguided reliance on AI tools may undermine independent reasoning.
Every student who uses AI fails to learn anything.
AI tools obviously destroy education completely.
questions.explanation: 学术写作使用 may / tend to 等模糊限制语，并限定条件（frequent unguided reliance），避免 always / every / obviously。

questions.prompt: Which option best nominalises the clause "Because cities expanded rapidly, housing became less affordable"?
options: Cities expanded very fast so houses cost more.
The rapid expansion of cities reduced housing affordability.
People saw cities grow and paid more rent.
Rapidly expanding cities are always expensive.
questions.explanation: 把动词短语 expanded rapidly 名词化为 the rapid expansion of cities，became less affordable 转为 reduced housing affordability。

questions.prompt: An author presents an argument that lacks strong empirical proof, and you want to report it cautiously. Which verb fits best?
questions.explanation: contend / claim 表达「声称/主张」且保留审慎距离，适用于尚有争议或证据不足的观点。
